notes.title: Space Vomit - Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[p][i]Space Vomit[/i] is a top-down roguelike bullet hell game where you must survive an alien invasion through randomized rounds, wiping out your enemies with powerful weapons while collecting perk cards and upgrades.[/p][p][/p][p]- Bosses big, huge, giants and powerful! [/p][p]- Kill all your enemies with a variety of amazing shots! [/p][p]- 30 enemies with unique characteristics! [/p][p]- Skill cards to survive![/p][p]- Upgrade book for your character and much more.
